card.name: Diagnosis guidance sentences before identify/consider
card.fires_on: Small words (to, is, include, patients) in label sentences that tell clinicians what to do when diagnosing or evaluating, such as 'it is important to identify' or 'must be considered in all patients'.

modes.label: Diagnostic importance phrase
modes.description: The words 'it is important to' in the neuroleptic-syndrome diagnosis passage, just before 'identify cases'.
modes.example: In arriving at a diagnosis, it is important<< to>> identify cases where the clinical presentation includes both

modes.label: Evaluation or consideration instruction
modes.description: Words in sentences saying what an evaluation should include or whom a diagnosis must be considered in.
modes.example: Evaluation of the hypertensive patient should always<< include>> assessment of renal function (see DOSAGE

modes.label: All patients who present
modes.description: The word patients after 'considered in all' in the diarrhea warning.
modes.example: CDAD must be considered in all<< patients>> who present with diarrhea following antibacterial drug

card.writes: Little clear effect; it weakly suppresses cause-related words like causing and contributing.
card.plain: It fires on the small words in sentences telling clinicians what to check or consider when working up a diagnosis.
